name: flowchart
title: Flowchart
summary: An agent workflow drawn as a trigger and its conditions on a canvas.
description: An agent workflow on a dotted canvas: a trigger node joined by a connector to an If / Else node. The trigger card opens a menu of triggers; each condition row reads as a sentence whose property and value are ghost sm selects. Rows reorder and delete through the row handle's menu (Move up, Move down, Remove), so reordering never needs a drag. Adding a condition reveals the new row once; nothing else animates. Composes select, menu and button; their behaviour comes from Zag in every target.

anatomy.description: Kind pill above a card; its kind (trigger or condition) is a recipe variant
Kind pill, tinted by the kind variant
Trigger: the button that is its Menu trigger (data-state=open|closed, marked data-menu="trigger"). Condition: role=group, labelled Conditions
Tinted 36px icon box of the trigger card
Says the card opens a menu; does not rotate
Connector between the nodes, drawn in CSS from color.line-strong; aria-hidden
Handle, joiner, clause. data-entering (set and cleared by the shared helper) while a row the pointer added is revealed; data-collapsed for its first frame (0fr)
Grip; the trigger of the row Menu (Move up, Move down, Remove; marked data-menu="trigger") and of our Tooltip with the same text. aria-label Condition N options
Source, property select, operator, value select; wraps under itself
The record the condition reads (e.g. order); title carries the full name
Truncates; the full name is the source's title
The real Button (ghost sm) Add condition, marked data-flowchart="add"

source.description: Name of the record the conditions read.

choices.description: Values per property: { [property]: { value, label, meta? }[] }.

conditions.description: The If / Else rows in order.

labels.description: The fixed strings, partial: { trigger, condition, conditions, if, and, is, addCondition, rowOptions, rowProperty, rowValue, moveUp, moveDown, remove }. {n} in rowOptions / rowProperty / rowValue is the row's number.

kind.description: Set per node; tints the kind pill and picks the card.

events.conditionsChange: (conditions: { id, property, value }[]) after a value or property change, an add, a move or a removal

a11y.role: group of conditions (ordered list) under a trigger menu button
keyboard: Tab order: trigger card, then per row the handle, the property select and the value select, then Add condition
Trigger card: Enter / Space / ArrowDown open the trigger menu (menu contract); picking a trigger updates the card and closes the menu; focus returns to the card
Row handle: Enter / Space / ArrowDown open Move up / Move down / Remove; after a move focus follows the row's handle, after a removal it lands on the next row's handle (or Add condition)
Property and value: the select contract; a new property resets the value to that property's first choice
Add condition: Enter / Space add a row and move focus to its property select; from the keyboard the row appears without the reveal
notes: Reordering never needs a drag: the handle's menu moves the row.
Every select and handle is labelled with its row number ('Condition 2 value').
The connector is decoration (aria-hidden); order is carried by the DOM.

motion: added row: it opens its room (its one grid row 0fr → 1fr over duration.reveal, easing.out-strong, clipped while it opens, so the card grows with it instead of snapping) while it fades up (fndn-fade-up over duration.enter, easing.out-strong), once (data-entering is removed when it ends, so a reorder cannot replay it); keyboard adds are instant
nothing else animates: no node drag, no connector draw, no caret rotation; reorders and removals are instant
trigger card and handle: colour / shadow feedback at duration.fast and duration.base; the selects, menus and button keep their own motion
